Features — Highlight Structure

  • Color-Coded Visualization: Different colors for divs and each heading level (h1-h6) for easy identification.
  • Toggle On/Off: Instantly toggle highlighting on or off without reloading the page.
  • Developer Friendly: Essential tool for web developers, designers, and SEO professionals.
  • Educational: Learn how webpages are built by seeing the underlying structure visually.
